maya: CI went red on my PR #4123 — integration-matrix shard 3 failed with a timeout, other shards green. Can I trigger just that shard without doing a full image rebuild?
liam: @maya yep. You can rerun the failing job from the GH Actions UI or with gh. To avoid rebuilding docker images set SKIP_IMAGE_BUILD=1 on the rerun.
maya: How do I pass that env via CLI?
liam: Quick steps: find the run id -> find the job id.
liam: ```
# list recent runs for the workflow
gh run list --workflow ci-matrix -L 10
# inspect a run to get job ids
gh run view <RUN_ID> --json jobs
# rerun only one job (replace JOB_ID)
gh run rerun <RUN_ID> --job <JOB_ID>
```
liam: We don't have a first-class --env on all gh versions, so two options: 1) use the web UI "Re-run jobs" + set env in the workflow_dispatch form if available, or 2) our Slack bot supports a preserve-cache + skip-image flag.
arjun: For reference, the helper is `/retest job <JOB_ID> preserve-cache skip-image` — that maps to an internal API that sets preserveCache=true and SKIP_IMAGE_BUILD=1.
ci-bot: Received request: targeted rerun for JOB_ID=8423 (PR #4123). preserve_cache=true, skip_image=true. Status: queued. :rocket:
sre-oncall: Small tip — if it's a flaky test, do one targeted rerun first. If it still fails, rerun the whole matrix once. If it fails deterministically across reruns, we should bisect.
maya: Thanks, ci-bot queued it. I'll monitor. If it flakes again I'll mark the test and open an infra ticket.
liam: If you want me to run a bisect I can script a binary search across commits and run only the failing job in each commit to narrow it down. Ping me.
maya: Will do. Appreciate the fast help :thumbsup:
